clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he knew his name would be called before it was. At a school raffle in the 1970s, he picked an outcome, then focused on broadcasting it, what he calls the theta brainwave.

Two names were pulled. Neither was his. Then he stood up and started walking toward the stage before the third name was even read. It was his.

He says that was the moment he knew luck isn't random, it's something you can learn to direct.

Do you think your mindset can change your luck?
